verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee is API-first. The scraping itself is driven by documented API parameters: JS scenarios, extraction rules, AI query, proxies, screenshots and auto mode. Separate dedicated APIs cover search, ecommerce, YouTube, LLMs and account usage, and an official CLI adds crawls, exports and schedules. Missing for 10: an explicit UI/API parity statement, evidence of API access to account, billing and API-key management, scheduling exposed directly in the HTTP API rather than via the gated CLI, and a published OpenAPI spec (probe found none).
